description: NotebookLM is Google's AI research/notebook assistant. The free consumer product has no public API; a separate paid 'Gemini Notebook Enterprise' product exposes an official Google Cloud REST API.
access_notes: The free consumer NotebookLM product (notebooklm.google.com) has no official public API -- only unofficial reverse-engineered Python wrappers exist (e.g. notebooklm-py, explicitly labeled 'Unofficial'). A separate enterprise product, 'Gemini Notebook Enterprise', has an official Google Cloud REST API, but it requires setting up Gemini Notebook Enterprise and obtaining licenses via Google Cloud -- not self-serve, and marked 'Preview' under Pre-GA terms.
api_notes: The Enterprise API covers creating and managing notebooks; the free consumer product has no documented API surface at all.
main_blocker: The free consumer product has no public API; the only official API belongs to a separate paid/licensed enterprise product requiring Google Cloud setup.
